title: Optimal Embeddings of Constant-Dimensional Subspaces of $L^p$ into $\ell_p^N$
summary: For $d \geq 2$, $p \geq 1$ and $ε> 0$, let $N_p(d,ε)$ be the smallest integer $N$ such that every $d$-dimensional subspace of $L^p[0,1]$ admits a linear embedding into $\ell_p^N$ with distortion at most $1 + ε$. For fixed $d\geq 2$ and $p\geq 1$, the bound \[ N_p(d,ε) \lesssim_{d,p} ε^{-2(d-1)/(d+2p)} \] is established. For $p \notin 2\mathbb{Z}$, this matches the known lower bound up to constant factors.
